description: A picturesque stretch of white sand, fringed with palm trees & palapas & known for its calm waters. Polem Beach is the southernmost beach in Goa. This is a place where South Goa beaches are ending and the Karnataka state sea coastline starts. Perfectly suited for tourists who are planning to have complete privacy and relaxation. Polem Beach is ideal for a laid-back retreat on the deserted sands with a breathtaking view to behold. Polem Beach is another very serene, uncrowded beach. It is a beautiful secluded beach that has stretches of white sands and rocky headlands. It is suitable for those who want to be away from crowded areas as it is a totally isolated beach. Polem Beach is very clean and unspoiled unlike the other commercial beaches of Goa. It is perfect for swimming and sunbathing. Situated at a distance of 91 km from Panjim and 77 km from Goa International Airport. One can take an auto or a cab or take a rented vehicle to reach Polem Beach. The best time to visit Talpona Beach is between October and March. Polem Beach is mainly a lonely place, so there is a huge possibility that except fishermen you won't meet anyone. few shacks which you will easily find at the beach you will be able to try fresh seafood dishes, soft drinks, and different refreshments. There are some water sports activities available at Polem beach like Kayaking, Paddling, Boat Rides. The accommodation in Polem Beach can't suggest to its visitors and guests lots of variants stay in, there are small houses made of cane with palm leaves roofs which would cost you about 200 rupees. Some other places one can visit near Polem are Talpona beach, Palolem beach, Galjibagh Beach.
